thread:
maya: Quick sync - thinking about adding an explicit 'abort and snapshot' button to rollout Console. Purpose: let ops pause and capture metrics + traces before rollback. Propose two actions: PAUSE (hold slices) and ABORT+SNAPSHOT (rollback + capture). Thoughts?
henry: Yes please. We get blind rollbacks sometimes. Snapshot should capture sample traces, last 1k requests, and eval-summary. Also include which cache token was active.
dana: UX note: make it clear to user that ABORT will trigger fallback model immediately and start cooldown. Also require a short reason field for audit.
leon: SRE: when abort happens, automatically pin fallback and set region cooldown 45m. Also create an incident stub with optional auto-open based on safety-tier. Recommend adding a 'dry-run' mode for internal tests.
maya: Flow: operator hits ABORT+SNAPSHOT -> system takes snapshot -> triggers rollback -> posts incident stub -> logs audit (actor, reason, metrics). Also show a preview modal with estimated impact.
henry: For metrics snapshot include p50/p95, error-rate, quality-eval delta, and request-volume. For traces capture 3 representative requests per error-class.
dana: From product: need copy for the modal and an inline help doc. Also make PAUSE reversible without a snapshot.
leon: We'll implement a guard: abort button disabled if region has active maintenance or if rollback cooldown active. Hook into status-service.
maya: Decision: implement PAUSE + ABORT+SNAPSHOT in Console for next sprint, default cooldown 45m, reason required, snapshot retention 7d. Internal dry-run flag enabled for staff.
ops-bot: rollout:update id=1855559999 status=initiated slice=1%
henry: Action: I'll draft snapshot schema + sample payload. owner=henry ETA 4d
dana: Action: I'll write modal copy + help doc. owner=dana ETA 2d
leon: Action: I'll wire cooldown + incident stub logic. owner=leon ETA 7d
maya: OK good plan. We'll test on an internal rollout next Tuesday. :thumbsup:
